description: Genomic neighbourhood map of the four KT2440 PuuD-family paralogs showing operon association with glutamate-putrescine ligases
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mp
# Genomic neighbourhood schematic built from the UniProt locus-tag queries run earlier (real retrieved annotations)
tracks = {
 "PP_2179 (spuA)": [("PP_2176","LysR reg",0),("PP_2177","reg",0),("PP_2178","puuA-I glutamate-putrescine ligase",2),
                    ("PP_2179","PuuD-like hydrolase",1),("PP_2180","spuC-I polyamine:pyruvate transaminase",2),
                    ("PP_2181","Cro/CI reg",0),("PP_2182","ProQ/FinO",0)],
 "PP_5298":        [("PP_5295","YicC",0),("PP_5296","gmk",0),("PP_5297","amino acid transporter",2),
                    ("PP_5298","PuuD-like hydrolase",1),("PP_5299","puuA-II glutamate-putrescine ligase",2),
                    ("PP_5300","LysR reg",0),("PP_5301","rpoZ",0)],
 "PP_3598":        [("PP_3595","artM arginine ABC permease",3),("PP_3596","amaD D-lysine oxidase",3),
                    ("PP_3597","amino acid ABC ATPase",3),("PP_3598","PuuD-like hydrolase",1),
                    ("PP_3599","5-dehydro-4-deoxyglucarate dehydratase",3),("PP_3600","gudP glucarate transporter",3),
                    ("PP_3601","garD galactarate dehydratase",3)],
 "PP_0727":        [("PP_0725","TPR protein",0),("PP_0726","transferase",0),("PP_0727","C26 GATase",1),
                    ("PP_0728","PEP-utilising enzyme",0),("PP_0729","PPDK ATP-binding",0),
                    ("PP_0730","ATP-grasp",0),("PP_0731","pcs",0)],
}
cols={0:"#d9d9d9",1:"#d94801",2:"#2171b5",3:"#41ab5d"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,5.2))
for yi,(k,genes) in enumerate(tracks.items()):
    y=len(tracks)-yi-1
    for xi,(tag,desc,c) in enumerate(genes):
        ax.add_patch(mp.FancyArrow(xi,y,0.86,0,width=0.34,head_width=0.34,head_length=0.14,
                                   length_includes_head=True,color=cols[c],ec="black",lw=0.5))
        ax.text(xi+0.43,y,tag.replace("PP_",""),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7.5,
                color="white" if c in (1,2,3) else "black")
        ax.text(xi+0.43,y-0.42,desc,ha="center",va="top",fontsize=6.3,rotation=0,wrap=True)
    ax.text(-0.25,y,k,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xlim(-3.2,7.2); ax.set_ylim(-0.9,len(tracks)-0.3); ax.axis("off")
handles=[mp.Patch(color=cols[1],label="PuuD-family hydrolase (PF07722)"),
         mp.Patch(color=cols[2],label="Putrescine / polyamine pathway gene"),
         mp.Patch(color=cols[3],label="Amino acid or sugar acid catabolism / transport"),
         mp.Patch(color=cols[0],label="Unrelated")]
ax.legend(handles=handles,loc="lower center",ncol=4,fontsize=7.5,frameon=False,bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,-0.08))
ax.set_title("Genomic context of the four P. putida KT2440 PuuD-family paralogs\n(annotations retrieved from UniProt proteome UP000000556)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
